finding.name: Missing Authorization
finding.summary: The order lookup starts from the correctly owner-scoped filter { _id, ownerId: req.user.id }, but then spreads a caller-supplied req.body.extra object into it, letting a caller override the ownerId key with a MongoDB operator (e.g. { "$ne": null }) and retrieve any user's order by _id since mongoose.sanitizeFilter() is never enabled.
